prompts.text: I have pretended to be sick to avoid a chore.
I have hidden a snack so nobody else would find it.
I have confidently sung the wrong words to a song.
I have blamed a pet for a noise I made.
I have taken the last cookie and hoped nobody noticed.
I have changed a board-game rule after the game started.
I have pretended to be asleep so I would not have to answer a question.
I have accidentally revealed a surprise gift.
I have left the house wearing two different socks.
I have called a teacher, coach, or neighbor the wrong name.
I have built a blanket fort and refused to take it down.
I have looked everywhere for something that was in my hand.
I have invented a rule during a game because it helped me.
I have started a car sing-along without checking whether anyone wanted one.
I have eaten dessert before dinner and called it a taste test.
I have volunteered someone else for a school project job.
Who in this room would organize the best family road trip?
Who in this room would make a tiny inconvenience sound like an adventure?
Who in this room would bring the best snacks to a sleepover?
Who in this room would get lost in a familiar neighborhood?
